annotations.text:
Repair in Place — dark only.

Same screens, same gestures, same vocabulary. Everything here is either a defect fixed in place or the one structural move (Markets takes the Widgets tab). Metrics are lifted from the real source: AssetRow's 20dp radius and 14×9 padding, the lens card's 16dp and 14dp, the 58×26 sparkline.

The whole direction in one screen.

YOUR MONEY — position, alerts, entry plan, options — now sits one screenful down instead of four, and the eleven lenses survive intact below it under three quiet section headers.

Every row is a door.

Holdings and AI verdict rows navigate to detail/{type}/{symbol} — the route that already exists. This is release R1: pure additions, no relocation risk, shippable in days.

The one structural move.

Five features that were each reachable through exactly one unlabelled glyph get a labelled front door with a live summary. The dip radar is reachable on a zero-dip day, which is the one state it cannot be opened from today.

R2 · Ink — the release that has to come first.

Every contrast ratio on this sheet was computed against the surface it is drawn on, not asserted. Going dark-only retires the top-ranked finding outright rather than repainting it.
